newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan beauty queens reach out in cyberspace.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan beauty queens reach out in cyberspace.

text.p: Venezuelan beauty queens, whose numerous Miss Universe and Miss World titles helped put their country on the map, will go live on the Internet.
The 29 contestants for this year's Miss Venezuela pageant will appear in skimpy swimsuits on the Web to allow admirers to vote for their favourite girl, organisers said on Wednesday.

Pictures of the girls, along with audio interviews and video clips, will appear at http://www.missvenezuela.com on August 18 and voting will close on the eve of the September 12 pageant, said Maria Eugenia Mosquera, manager of the site.
"We briefly tested it last year but this is the first time the girls will be on the Internet. It will be interesting to compare the Internet vote with the real one," she said.

In Venezuela, beauty queens are treated like royalty and even launch political careers, as in the case of Irene Saez, a 35-year-old blonde who won the Miss Universe title in 1981 and is setting her sights on the presidency next year.
